Feature.Description: C01 proposal for a single cooled snap-cap tube station. No server is implemented. The originator is a provisional project namespace, not a registered standard feature. See docs/tube-station-c01.md for required preconditions and recovery semantics.

Command.Description: Atomically reserve the station for one orchestrator. Repeated acquisition does not replace an existing owner.

Response.Description: Exclusive control token; explicit release or local recovery required.

Command.Description: Release ownership only when empty, motionless and without a robot access grant.

Parameter.Description: Opaque coordination token scoped to the current BootId; not an authentication credential.

Command.Description: Refresh the owner watchdog. Loss of heartbeats inhibits new motion and latches recovery; it never authorizes automatic closure or ownership transfer.

Parameter.Description: Opaque coordination token scoped to the current BootId; not an authentication credential.

Command.Description: Home and park fingers and release the retainer only with an empty nest and independently clear workspace. Reset cooling readiness on configuration change.

Parameter.Description: Opaque coordination token scoped to the current BootId; not an authentication credential.
Only a measured and qualified tube article profile may be selected.
When true, pipetting access additionally requires validated cooling readiness.

Command.Description: Require measured standstill, parked fingers, Ready mode and no fault or other grant. Atomically inhibit all station actuation before granting robot entry. Loading requires empty/released; Pipetting requires secured/open and cooling ready if requested; Unloading requires verified closed/released. Exactly one grant may exist.

Parameter.Description: Opaque coordination token scoped to the current BootId; not an authentication credential.

Response.Description: Unique token for one robot access grant.

Command.Description: Robot reports fully withdrawn. Revoke the grant only after an independent clearance input also confirms the workspace clear. A failed request leaves motion inhibited.

Parameter.Description: Opaque coordination token scoped to the current BootId; not an authentication credential.
The active grant returned by BeginAccess.

Command.Description: With robot access ended and workspace independently clear: verify tube and orientation, secure it, lift and park the lid, park both fingers and verify the open position. Successful completion means these checks passed.

Parameter.Description: Opaque coordination token scoped to the current BootId; not an authentication credential.

Command.Description: With robot access ended and workspace independently clear: close with force/displacement limits, verify latching, park fingers, then release retainer. Failure keeps tube retained. Verified latching does not claim a leak-tight seal.

Parameter.Description: Opaque coordination token scoped to the current BootId; not an authentication credential.

Command.Description: Priority controlled-stop request available to any authenticated client, even while a motion command is running. Latch RecoveryRequired and retain current access inhibition and tube support. This is not an emergency stop and does not certify that physical motion has already stopped.

Property.Description: One coherent, versioned snapshot. Publish on state change and at the configured period. Sequence increases within BootId. All fields are project-defined, not standard SiLA states.

Element.Description: New UUID after every server/controller restart; old control/access tokens become invalid.
Monotonically increasing snapshot sequence within BootId.
UTC time of this coherent snapshot; client also checks local receipt age.
Exactly NeedsInitialization, Initializing, Ready, Opening, Closing, Stopping or RecoveryRequired. Robot access is represented separately.
Selected qualified tube profile, or empty string.
Presence sensor; not identity or orientation proof.
True only when retention is positively confirmed.
Exactly Unknown, ClosedVerified, OpenVerified or InTransit.
Exactly None, Loading, Pipetting or Unloading. Any active grant inhibits station actuation.
Independent local clearance input. False or stale inhibits motion; no clearance safety performance is claimed.
Measured standstill confirmation; not inferred from StopMotion RPC completion.
The selected run requires cooling readiness for pipetting access.
Degrees Celsius; meaningful only when BlockTemperatureValid is true. Not sample temperature.
False on failed or stale block sensing; numeric field must be ignored then.
True only with a qualified thermal profile, valid block sensing, required soak and valid cooling checks. No sample-temperature guarantee from this Boolean alone.
None or the current defined error identifier; unknown state requires recovery.

Property.Description: Identifiers of implemented, experimentally qualified tube profiles. Empty for this unimplemented C01 draft.

DefinedExecutionError.Description: Required cooling checks failed or are not yet complete.
Token does not match the active access grant.
Token missing, unknown, stale or from another boot.
Command preconditions failed; no new actuation is permitted.
Motion timeout, overload, following error or feedback failure; retain support and require recovery.
Another orchestrator owns the station; do not steal or auto-expire its access.
Local inspection and controlled recovery are required before further actuation.
Presence, orientation or retention verification failed.
Tube profile is absent or unqualified; nominal volume is insufficient.
Open or latch verification failed; do not report success.
Robot clearance is false or stale; retain inhibition.
